about: Fade-out of a status visual on the client: an entity handle, the current opacity and the fade speed (1 / fade time). Added by the status visual state machine bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 (state 4 -> 5) and run by the per-frame update of ecl::statusVisual::FadeSystem (bg3.exe+0x1A55070, query FadeComponent + ls::VisualComponent), which lowers the opacity each frame and destroys the visual when it drops to 1/256. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row). The savegame model game.crowds.v0.FadeComponent matched by short name belongs to a crowds component, not to this one.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x1BF6D20 (AllocRaw 0x10) writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle) at +0. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes the entity handle its second argument points to at +0 (an entity handle passed in by the status visual code). Which entity (visual owner vs. status) is not established.

Creator writes dword 0 at +8. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes the float at +0x30 of the status visual (only when >= 1/256). FadeSystem update bg3.exe+0x1A55070 subtracts GameTime.DeltaTime (at +8 of the game time) times the float at +0xC from the float at +8; if the result is above 0.00390625 (1/256) it stores it back at +8 and applies it, otherwise it removes the component.
Creator writes 0x3F800000 (1.0f) at +0xC. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes 1.0 divided by the float at +0x4C of the settings (1 / fade duration); the update multiplies DeltaTime by it.
